title: Surface chat failures with a direct recovery path
goal: Show runtime submission errors inside Chat and give users a direct route to provider/model settings without hiding the underlying error.
context: Issue #367 prioritizes completing the Chat workflow. KernelSession publishes lastError on failed submissions, but ChatScreen currently does not render that error inline.
forbidden_changes: Do not retry by resubmitting and duplicating user turns.
Do not suppress or rewrite the original error detail.
Do not change Kernel/runtime execution behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A non-empty session.lastError is visible in the Chat screen next to the composer.
The underlying error text can be selected/copied.
A direct navigation action opens Settings for provider/model recovery.
New UI labels are localized in Vietnamese and English.
verification: Review the ChatScreen diff and localization entries.
Run validate-contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA.
Confirm the error banner disappears when a new submission clears lastError; verify on device separately.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if the banner causes navigation or SwiftUI build regressions.
